Overview

  • Embark on a journey to discover the breathtaking Marietas Islands and their hidden beach.

    • Fall in love with Hidden Beach, also known locally as “Lover's Beach,” a natural wonder nestled within a volcanic crater formed millions of years ago by the island's natural erosion.

    • Explore its coral reefs teeming with beautiful schools of fish.

    • Enjoy the prickly pear cactus beach with its white sand and venture into the caves formed by the island's volcanic rock.

    • Be thrilled to observe the more than 80 different species of birds that inhabit the islands, including the rare blue-footed booby, an emblem of these islands.

    • Visit the stone bridge, a crater similar to Hidden Beach, where you can capture some of the best photos of your entire vacation with your partner or family.

    Don't miss this opportunity and let us show you our little paradise in the middle of the sea.

Activity itinerary

Marietas Islands

  • 3h
  • Admission ticket included
Our adventure begins at the meeting point, where we'll get acquainted and provide you with valuable information for our Marietas Islands adventure. Afterward, we'll board our boat and meet our crew, who will be responsible for transportation, information, and safety during our adventure. Upon arrival at the island, we'll meet the park rangers who protect and care for this beautiful natural reserve. Then, the water activities begin, starting with snorkeling in one of the best areas in the entire Mexican Pacific to enjoy the wide variety of fish and marine life. We'll also visit Playa Nopalera, a small but beautiful white-sand beach where you can take photos and relax. Next comes the best part: Playa Escondida (Hidden Beach). Unique in the world for being inside a beautiful crater below sea level, we'll enjoy being in one of nature's most exquisite wonders. We'll conclude by exploring the surroundings of these islands.
